LGPL-2.1 section 5 permits object code using only numerical parameters, data-structure layouts/accessors and small macros/inline functions from headers without restriction. This assessment is limited to these exact header-derived files, not a general libc licence exemption. Keep source notices. The same generated file also preserves the GCC stddef.h GPL-3.0-or-later notice with explicit GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1. It supplies basic C type definitions, not a linked GCC implementation. This exact-file pre-cut assessment preserves that notice and requires removal before product release; it does not approve importing or shipping libc.
